name: Extractive Metallurgy & Metal Production
summary: Explains how metals are won from ores and scrap by mineral processing, pyrometallurgy, hydrometallurgy and electrometallurgy.

topics.name: Ores, minerals and mineral processing: comminution, flotation and concentration
Thermodynamics of extraction: Ellingham diagrams and predominance diagrams
Pyrometallurgy: roasting, smelting, converting and refining; slags
Ironmaking in the blast furnace and hydrogen-based direct reduction
Hydrometallurgy: leaching, solvent extraction and precipitation
Electrometallurgy: electrowinning and electrorefining; Hall-Héroult aluminium process
Production of titanium (Kroll process) and emerging routes
Rare-earth and battery-metal extraction (Li, Ni, Co)
Vacuum and special melting: VIM, VAR and ESR for aerospace alloys
Energy use and decarbonisation of metal production
Recycling as metal production: secondary aluminium and steel
